title: Task 1 & Task 2 — HTML Webpage Title & JavaScript Heading via document.write()
topic: Unit 10: Programming in JavaScript (Input and Output Functions)
apparatus: Computer, Printer, Notepad, Web Browser, and MS Word (for code printout submission)
description:
• Task 1 (1 Mark): Write the HTML code to display 'Candidate Name and Candidate ID' in the title of the webpage.
• Task 2 (1 Mark): Write the JavaScript code to display the heading 'Sum of Natural Numbers' using document.write().

title: Task 3 & Task 4 — JavaScript prompt() Input & for Loop Sum of Natural Numbers
topic: Unit 10: Programming in JavaScript (prompt() Input & for Loop Structure)
description:
• Task 3 (1 Mark): Write JavaScript code to accept a natural number from the user using the prompt() function and store it in a variable.
• Task 4 (2 Marks): Write the JavaScript code to use a for loop to calculate the sum of all natural numbers till the entered number.

title: Task 5, Task 6 & Task 7 — Display Output via document.write(), alert() Confirmation & Printout
topic: Unit 10: Programming in JavaScript (document.write() & window.alert() Output)
apparatus: Computer, Printer, Notepad, Web Browser, and MS Word
description:
• Task 5 (1 Mark): Display the entered number and the calculated sum using document.write() ('Entered Number: 5' / 'Sum of Natural Numbers: 15').
• Task 6 (1 Mark): Show the message 'Program Executed Successfully' in an alert() box.
• Task 7 (1 Mark): Print the source program and the output with your candidate ID and centre ID.

title: Class X Practical Journal / Portfolio Verification
topic: Endorsed Practical Lab Journal (Class X JavaScript & Digital Literacy Practical Activities)
description: Practical journal/portfolio developed by the student across the academic session and endorsed by the subject teacher or principal, submitted during the Paper III Practical Examination (2 Marks).
